quests.title: The Clock at Tramway Avenue
quests.blurb: The clock on the Tramway Avenue platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Find out who set it that way, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Rosehill Gardens, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Central
quests.blurb: A dog meets the 5:40 at Central every weekday and nobody gets off for it. Four months of this. I have decided it is not going to be a sad story. Find out whose it is.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Westmead Hospital
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races — weather, delays, whether the five in the morning out of Westmead Hospital runs on time. Somebody is beating it by information, not luck. Ride the run they ride.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$44 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Warrawee
quests.blurb: The last one through Warrawee carries four people and one of them is always asleep. Ride it to Wahroonga, photograph the platform with nobody on it, and come back and tell me the place still exists when there is no one in it.

steps.label: ride the late one to Wahroonga
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Kogarah Tap-Off
quests.blurb: A card ending 50 boards at Kogarah on the long weekend and vanishes. Not a fare thing — ninety cents. I want to know *how*, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Denistone Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Denistone. Since the week of the show they have not turned up, and they keep sending a different bloke. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the Denistone kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $40 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Benaud Oval
quests.blurb: The board at Benaud Oval says four minutes. It has said four minutes since before the merge and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand under it, time it, and bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Croydon
quests.blurb: Everything anyone leaves on the Croydon line ends up in a room and the room is full. Nine hundred umbrellas and one a esky with no lid with a name on it and a number that rings out. Go to the address on the tag.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$38 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Turrella
quests.blurb: Speakerphone. School holidays, Turrella to town, speakerphone. I have made eye contact eleven times and it has achieved nothing.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Hills Showground Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier has a route that is not on a map and mine goes through Hills Showground. They have started locking one end. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$42, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Regents Park
quests.blurb: We own the track between midnight and four and in that window we are the only people in this city doing anything real. Somebody keeps walking through my possession at Regents Park. Find them before a grinder does.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Dundas Regular
quests.blurb: A man drank in my front bar by Dundas for 12 years and then stopped, and every regular in here has gone vague on me at once, which means they know. You are not from here. Go and knock.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Woy Woy
quests.blurb: People have started parking on the grass at Woy Woy because of one abandoned car, and it has been like that since the merge. Photograph it, and the date on the ticket, so somebody can be embarrassed by it.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$38 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Austinmer
quests.blurb: Council pays me to paint over things and last week I painted over something good. There is another one near Austinmer that I am scheduled to kill on school holidays. Photograph it first.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: The Hill Above Vineyard
quests.blurb: I drive past the same view above Vineyard eleven times a shift and I have never once stopped at it. You have got legs and no timetable. Go up and photograph what I have been driving past for 9 years.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$42, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at Dulwich Hill
quests.blurb: Two hundred and eighty-five dollars at Dulwich Hill for a thing the sign did not say, because the sign is not there. The form wants evidence. Go and photograph the absence.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Merrylands
quests.blurb: Nobody planted the strip at Merrylands. I did, on a wet Monday, at the back of seven, so nobody would ask. I would like the fifteenth to go badly for council.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Parramatta
quests.blurb: Ten to six, nobody in the building but us and a radio that gets one station. Somebody has been taking things and they know our roster, which means they come in off the late train at Parramatta.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$48 of what they took, back

quests.title: The Window Above Eastwood

tell me I am not mad
